text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for spending time with me today.
choice_data_list: You sure bought a whole bunch of stuff.
You really bought a lot of things, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Some snacks that got popular on social media,
along with age-appropriate fashion magazines and a few little gifts.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of them is completely commonplace.
They are commonplace, and that is precisely why they are necessary.

Is she using it as a conversation starter to make friends?
I can't say for sure, but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Found you at last!
You heart-manipulating witch-girl!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Me?
Now, I wonder what you could mean...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Don't play dumb! I saw you manipulating the minds of the Student Council members!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Ah, you mean the budget negotiations back then?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The people who were against it at first
did a total one-eighty!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, not at all.
I merely offered a simple suggestion
so that everyone may lead fulfilling days."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "We ultimately received a substantial budget, but beyond that—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I care what you do
with the student council anyway!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What I want to know is your magic!
The magic that completely changed their minds!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Magic?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I want to use it too! That magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I asked before if we could make the academy's flowerbed bigger, but they told me no.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So I had no choice but to plant the seedlings crammed together,
but even the flowers must feel suffocated like that!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want you to teach me magic.
So I can make the flowerbeds even bigger!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I see.
That is a very... pure wish...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Straightforward feelings with no ulterior motives or scheming...
I find that quite endearing.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What's that?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu, please don't let it bother you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Understood, Sweep-san.
Allow me to teach you the magic that moves people's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "However, this isn't something that can be achieved overnight, so we'll need to take it step by step..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
First, let's see. Why don't we begin
by guessing what's on that person's mind?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, I'll start the fortune-telling I learned.
I'm gonna ask questions, so answer honestly!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Do you want someone to recognize your talent, or
is there something you actually want the world to know more about?
choice_data_list: True, I guess I can be like that sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...! Heh~? So I guessed right.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Are you hoping to work really hard right now
in order to fulfill that?
Her plausible-sounding words make me nod without thinking.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh, no way? This is a winner too?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then, the final question. You wish to aim even higher
alongside a specific someone!

I couldn't hide my shock at the fact
that they had guessed it dead on.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing, every single one hit!
Alright!! Isn't this a huge success!?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I am so glad you liked it.
Shall we save... the rest for next time?

With a big smile and a firm nod,
Sweep Tosho offered her thanks and left the scene.
choice_data_list: Just like a real master sorcerer!

text_block_list.text:
With a big smile and a firm nod,
Sweep Tosho offered her thanks and left the scene.
choice_data_list: Just like a real master sorcerer!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I merely taught a commonplace technique.

Dream Journey simply smiles and speaks.
I seem to recall hearing that certain fortune-tellers use specific methods of psychological guidance, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, I managed to draw those words out of you
in an unexpected way. ...Fufu, not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Then, as someone who is instructing me,
would that make you something like a Great Sage?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Well, jokes aside—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Gaining more trustworthy friends like this truly brings joy, doesn't it?
